item.summiteer.climbing_gloves.desc: Warm hands, and a faster climb with the ice axe or on rope. Right-click to wear
item.summiteer.snow_goggles.desc: See further in a whiteout. Right-click to wear
item.summiteer.crampons.desc: No slipping on ice, walk on powder snow, steadier in the wind. Right-click to wear
item.summiteer.ice_axe.desc: Walk into snow or ice to climb, or rock above the treeline; sneak to hang on
item.summiteer.rope.desc: Right-click an anchor to hang it down the drop; sneak-right-click to reel it in
block.summiteer.anchor.desc: Place at a cliff edge, facing the drop, then right-click it with rope
message.summiteer.rope.no_room: No room below the anchor to hang rope
message.summiteer.rope.full: This rope is as long as an anchor holds
